away.summary: The Rangers begin the season with a 0-0-0 record, relying on Igor Shesterkin as their projected starting goaltender. They will be without defenseman Vincent Iorio due to a lower-body injury, and have scratched Jaroslav Chmelar, Matthew Robertson, and Scott Morrow from the lineup. The team looks to build chemistry with a mix of veterans and young talent in their opening game against the Bruins.

home.summary: The Bruins open the season 0-0-0 with Jeremy Swayman projected to start in goal. They will be without forward Matt Poitras due to a lower-body injury and defenseman Charlie McAvoy serving a six-game suspension. David Pastrnak has been named the new team captain, marking a leadership transition as Boston begins its campaign against the Rangers.
